observation.command: echo "=== Guide-required deployment dirs/env ==="; echo "DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT=${DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-<unset>}"; echo "XPLANBOX_CONFIG=${XPLANBOX_CONFIG:-<unset>}"; ls -la /opt/deegree /opt/xplanbox /root/.deegree /root/xplanbox 2>&1 | head; echo; echo "=== Tomcat instances (guide needs 3) ==="; find / -maxdepth 5 -name "catalina.sh" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== deployed webapps ==="; find / -name "xplan-services-wms.war" 2>/dev/null | grep -v target; echo "=== external services ==="; for p in 5432 5672 8080 8081 8082; do timeout 2 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$p" 2>/dev/null && echo "$p OPEN" || echo "$p closed"; done
